hooks.prompt: Check if stopping is appropriate. Read the latest STATUS and PLAN files in .agent_planning/ to determine project completion. APPROVE stopping ONLY if: (1) all planned phases are complete, OR (2) the user explicitly asked to stop, OR (3) waiting for user input/decision. If tasks remain incomplete and no blocker exists, REJECT and instruct Claude to continue with the next phase using /dev-loop:test-and-implement.
